## Constants

- `BROWSER_CREDENTIAL_ACTUATION_RECEIPT_FORMAT` — Operator-bound credential actuation for one exact leased document field. Remote models receive only opaque handles and redacted receipts. The trusted extension worker decrypts a password or derives a TOTP value only after a one-use action sequence and exact lease have been consumed. Passkeys remain native user-presence ceremonies and are never materialized here.
